about: #72: a new game to the five faces of the elder, then walks to the stars of the healer, the teacher, and the smith (each ends next to the person, with the person in the middle of the view), a tap on the teacher during another walk, and Nghé beside the smith.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

steps.print: (() => { const h = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position; const p = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'npc:healer')?.position; return p ? Math.round(Math.hypot(h.x - p.x, h.z - p.z) / 2 * 10) / 10 : null; })()
